summary: Grace Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 4,761,904 common shares at $2.10 per share, raising approximately $10 million gross, with Craig-Hallum Capital Group as placement agent. The offering closed August 6, 2026, and includes a registration rights agreement to register resale shares. This is a routine equity financing, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructurings. The filing includes standard lock-up and standstill provisions but lacks any transformative event. The transaction is categorized as ordinary capital raising, thus no special-situation classification applies.
